name: multiply_32_bit_integers
description: Multiplies two 32-bit inputs using 16-bit partial products, returning the low 32 bits of the product. The second input is also returned with its two 16-bit halves swapped.

name: call_routine_from_global_table
description: Calls the routine whose address is stored at a fixed offset inside a global data block. It passes no arguments and returns nothing, so the target is not identified by this code.

name: store_byte_through_pointer
description: Writes the low byte of the first data register to the memory location held in the A3 pointer register. It is a single-byte store with no checks.

name: allocate_and_initialize_block
description: Allocates a fixed-size memory block with a library call and fills in a stored parameter, a flag byte and a value from a second call. If allocation fails it releases an earlier resource and returns zero, otherwise it returns the block address.

name: reset_object_and_recurse
description: When an object's link field is set, it first processes the object again through the same routine. It then fills a byte and a longword of the object with all ones and calls two other routines with the byte and a fixed value.

name: forward_argument_with_fixed_code
description: Passes its argument to another routine together with a fixed numeric code. It returns nothing itself.

name: pass_argument_through
description: Passes its single argument straight to another routine and returns nothing. It adds no logic of its own.

name: setup_trashcan_drawer_state
description: Saves a field of an existing object, fills a block of global variables from that object or from defaults, and calls library routines to build the related functions. The referenced text is a Trashcan drawer path in the system directory.

name: read_signed_byte_or_fail
description: Reads one byte through a routine that takes a handle, a buffer and a count of one. It returns that byte sign-extended when exactly one byte was read, and minus one otherwise.

name: call_library_function_no_args
description: Calls a library function through a vector stored in a global library base, passing no arguments. Its purpose cannot be determined from this code alone.

name: setup_pointer_chain
description: Points the first longword of a block to the field four bytes past its start, clears the next longword, and stores the block's own address in the third longword.

name: store_fields_in_new_node
description: If the first argument is non-null, allocates a node with a library call and stores a byte value, a word from the second argument and the pointer into fixed fields of it. It returns the node, or zero when there is no pointer or allocation fails.

name: reset_node_and_call_routine
description: If given a non-null node, sets its byte field and two longword fields to all ones, then passes the node and a stored word to another routine and returns that result. A null node returns zero.

name: call_library_routine_via_global
description: Calls a library function through a global library base at a fixed negative offset, passing no arguments. It returns nothing and the called function is unnamed.

name: call_library_vector_from_global
description: Calls a second library function through the same global library base at a different fixed negative offset, passing no arguments. The called function is unnamed in this code.

name: parse_command_line_and_run
description: Program entry point that allocates a task structure, splits the command-line text into words (handling quoted text and star escapes), and calls the main routine. It frees the structures it allocated and returns the result.

name: call_exec_supervisor_function
description: Calls the exec Supervisor function through a stored library base, passing no arguments. The routine is used to run code in supervisor mode.

name: exit_interrupt_handler
description: Ends an interrupt handler by calling the exec ExitIntr function through the stored library base. It passes no arguments and does not return normally.

name: invoke_task_switch_hook
description: Calls the exec Switch function through a stored library base, passing no arguments. It is invoked from the buffer preparation routine, where it gives control to another task.

name: invoke_task_dispatch_function
description: Calls the exec Dispatch function through a stored library base, passing no arguments. It is invoked from the buffer preparation routine to choose the next ready task.

name: call_exec_make_functions
description: Calls the exec MakeFunctions routine through a stored library base, passing no arguments from this code. It is called from two places in the program entry code.

name: call_exec_find_resident
description: Calls the exec FindResident routine through a stored library base, passing no arguments from this code. The result is returned to the caller unchanged.

name: enable_interrupts_through_exec
description: Calls the exec Enable routine through a stored library base to re-allow interrupts. It passes no arguments and has no result of its own.

name: call_exec_alloc_entry

name: open_shell_window_and_start

name: build_linked_node_list
description: Builds a singly linked list from a source list, allocating an 8-byte node for each entry and storing a value derived from the entry's second field. It links the nodes in order and returns the first node, stopping early if an allocation or the value step fails.

name: free_linked_node_list

name: parse_signed_decimal

description: Calls another routine four times, passing a value from a structure field together with each of four entries in a fixed global array.

name: validate_input_buffer
description: Checks up to eighty bytes of a buffer against a set of accepted byte ranges. It returns zero when all eighty bytes are accepted and one at the first byte outside those ranges.

name: wait_and_read_key_code
description: Waits for an input signal with a timeout and returns zero when a termination flag is set. Otherwise it reads a key code, zeroes certain codes depending on the flags, and returns the resulting value.

name: call_two_routines_then_jump
description: Calls one routine with a global value and another with no arguments, then makes an indirect call through a pointer. The referenced text covers file reopening and help prompts, but this fragment's purpose cannot be stated beyond these calls.

name: initialize_and_run_page_loop
description: Sets two state fields to their starting values, calls a routine to set up a result, then repeatedly calls another routine while a counter is positive, the position is before the end and a stop flag is clear.

name: update_entity_and_increment_counter
description: Calls two routines on a structure's buffer, stores the second result in a field, and when a flag field is zero it increments a short counter reached through a pointer in the structure.

name: scan_buffer_for_line_end
description: Scans a buffer up to its stored size, stopping at a newline or form-feed character, and records how many bytes were scanned. A form feed is replaced by a two-character marker and sets a flag for the next page.

name: run_pager_display_loop
description: Repeatedly fills and draws up to nine to fourteen lines of text, reads a key, and stops when the key is q or the control-C code. The line count depends on the window flags, and a scheduler call is made during each pass.

name: run_search_with_prompt
description: Chooses one of two global strings from a flag, then runs a search step and loops while the result is zero, updating a counter. It shows a searching prompt that names the string, and returns zero when the loop ends.

name: run_handler_sequence_and_return
description: Runs a fixed sequence of calls to another routine, passing a global and values from a parameter block, and returns the result of its main call. It finishes with two cleanup calls.

name: call_then_conditional_follow_up
description: Calls another routine with two arguments, then calls it again with one argument only when a short field in the parameter block is zero.

name: call_two_routines_with_bounds
description: Calls one routine with a stored value and a fixed negative argument, then calls another routine with a field from a nested structure. Both callees are unnamed in this code.

name: call_routines_with_range_end
description: Calls one routine with a stored value, a zero and a one, then calls another with a field from a nested structure reduced by one. Both callees are unnamed in this code.

name: iterate_text_buffer_lines
description: Iterates over a text buffer line by line, counting lines and stopping at a line limit, a stop flag or a special character. Line length is capped at 128 characters.

name: call_handler_then_forward_pointer
description: Calls another routine with its second argument, then calls a further routine with a pointer taken from the structure together with a global value.

name: set_flag_and_forward
description: When a field in the parameter block is zero, sets a short value in a linked structure to one. It then calls another routine with a field from the block and a global value.

name: select_and_forward_by_flag
description: Chooses between two values depending on a flag in the parameter block, then calls another routine with a field from the block and the chosen values.

name: dispatch_handler_by_flag
description: Calls another routine with a field from the block and either three copies of a global value or a field from a nested structure, depending on a flag.

name: clamp_negative_result
description: Calls another routine twice with the same first argument, once with a flag of one and once with minus one, and returns the second result clamped to zero if it is negative.

name: consume_from_buffer
description: Takes up to a requested number of bytes from a buffer whose size is recorded in a structure. It refills the buffer when the request exceeds the available bytes, copies the bytes to the caller's destination, advances the offset fields, and returns the number taken.

name: refill_buffer_to_full_size
description: Moves any buffered bytes to the start of the buffer when it is full, resets the offset fields, then fills the remaining space of a 4096-byte buffer by calling another routine. It adds the count returned to the stored size and returns that count, or zero when the buffer is not full.

name: update_scroll_window_position
description: Computes a target position from a selector and an offset, using the window's start, end and length fields. It returns minus one for an invalid selector, and otherwise checks the target against the window bounds before adjusting it.

name: read_line_from_buffer
description: Reads characters one at a time from a source into a buffer, stopping after a newline or a limit of 127 characters, and adds a terminating zero. It returns the number of characters read before the terminator.

name: copy_null_terminated_string
description: Copies bytes from a source string to a destination, including the terminating zero, and stops after copying the zero.

name: convert_string_to_uppercase
description: Converts each lowercase ASCII letter in a null-terminated string to uppercase in place, leaving other bytes unchanged.

name: parse_signed_decimal
description: Parses a signed decimal integer from a null-terminated string, accepting an optional leading sign and then decimal digits. It returns the signed value.

name: call_library_function_when_set
description: Calls a library function with a fixed argument of minus one, but only when the given pointer and a stored base pointer are both non-null. It returns nothing.

name: close_pager_window_and_cleanup
description: Cleans up the pager window state by calling routines that release saved pointers and reset fields, reads characters until a newline code, and then re-enables and reschedules through library calls. Its exact sequence is only partly visible.

name: send_single_value_message
description: Stores its argument in a one-element stack buffer and passes it, with a fixed numeric code, to a routine that uses a handle taken from a stored structure. It returns that routine's result.

name: copy_block_fields_and_release
description: Allocates a 36-byte block and passes it to a routine with a fixed code, then copies two fields from the block into the caller's structure and frees the block. It returns zero when allocation fails.

name: initialize_object_from_template
description: Obtains a handle from a routine, allocates a 68-byte object, links its fields to the handle and a source block, and copies a count of longwords from the source into it. It then calls routines to attach the object and release the handle.

name: reschedule_tasks_via_exec
description: Calls the exec Reschedule routine through the stored library base, passing no arguments.

name: invoke_task_switch_hook
description: Calls the exec Switch function through the stored library base, passing no arguments.

name: invoke_task_dispatch_function
description: Calls the exec Dispatch function through the stored library base, passing no arguments.

name: allocate_memory_via_exec
description: Calls the exec AllocMem function through the stored library base, passing no arguments from this code.

name: call_library_vector_no_args
description: Calls a library function through the stored base at a fixed negative offset, passing no arguments. The function is unnamed in this code.

name: call_library_vector_no_args

name: forward_with_stack_slot
description: Forwards two arguments to another routine together with a pointer to a stack slot. It returns nothing itself.

name: read_signed_byte_or_fail
description: Reads one byte through a routine that takes a handle, a buffer and a count of one. It returns that byte sign-extended when exactly one byte was read, and minus one otherwise.
